security_audit.summary: Four predictable temporary-file writes create overwrite and local symlink risks. Other alerts concern Markdown syntax, public postal downloads, extension descriptions, and expected data reads. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: Download examples write to predictable filenames in the shared temporary directory.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private directory with mktemp -d, store all downloads inside it, and clean it up after use. Avoid elevated execution.

content.user_title: Find Taiwan Postal Codes and English Address Names
content.value_statement: Taiwan postal prefixes and English address names can be difficult to match across official tables. This skill guides lookups using public Chunghwa Post datasets.
actual_capabilities: Look up three-digit postal code prefixes for Taiwan cities, townships, and districts.
Find official English names for counties, cities, and townships in the public XML table.
Look up village, named lane, road, and street translations in public text tables.
Guide English address assembly from smaller address components to larger administrative areas.
Explain Big5 text conversion and direct reading of UTF-8 XML files.
Identify ambiguous road names and refer unsupported lookups to official postal resources.
limitations: Full six-digit delivery codes are outside scope; use the official postal query service.
The three-digit table is dated 2014; administrative boundary changes require official confirmation.
Translations use Hanyu Pinyin, not passport-specific or custom romanization.
Lookups require network access and local command-line tools; duplicate names and changing download filenames can prevent definitive matches.

use_cases.title: Prepare an English mailing address
use_cases.description: Find official English address components and a three-digit postal prefix before completing an international mailing label.

use_cases.title: Check customer address names
use_cases.description: Compare road and district names with postal tables, and identify addresses requiring clarification or a six-digit lookup.

use_cases.title: Review address data mappings
use_cases.description: Inspect county, village, and road translation datasets while accounting for encoding differences and duplicate names.

prompt_templates.title: Find a postal prefix
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the three-digit postal code for [city] and [district] in Taiwan. State the table date and any uncertainty.

prompt_templates.title: Translate a road name
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the official English name for [Chinese road name] in [city and district]. Flag duplicate entries and missing matches.

prompt_templates.title: Assemble an English address
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert [Taiwan address] using official county, village, and road tables. Preserve supplied numbers, identify missing components, and never invent six-digit codes.

prompt_templates.title: Review a dataset workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan lookups for [address list] using official tables. Use private temporary storage, verify downloads, convert Big5 text, and flag ambiguous names.

output_examples.input: What is the three-digit postal code for Daan District in Taipei City?
output_examples.output: Daan District, Taipei City: 106. This is a three-digit prefix, not a full six-digit delivery code. Confirm boundary-sensitive cases through Chunghwa Post.

output_examples.input: How is Yigong Road written in the official English road-name table?
output_examples.output: Official road-name spelling: Yigong Rd. A road name alone does not establish a complete address or identify its city.

output_examples.input: Can you calculate the last three digits of my six-digit postal code?
output_examples.output: This skill does not determine the final three digits. Use the official Chunghwa Post postal code query for the full delivery code.

best_practices: Provide the city and district alongside the road or village name to resolve duplicate names.
Use a private temporary directory and verify download success before processing any table.
Convert Big5 text to UTF-8, leave UTF-8 XML unchanged, and confirm boundary-sensitive codes through official queries.
anti_patterns: Guessing the final three digits of a six-digit delivery code.
Treating a road-name match without city context as a unique address.
Substituting invented translations when the official tables contain no match.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No API key or login is needed for the public download tables. Network access is required.

faq.question: Does this skill provide full six-digit postal codes?
faq.answer: No. It covers three-digit prefixes and directs full delivery-code requests to the official postal query.

faq.question: Which English spelling system does it use?
faq.answer: It uses Hanyu Pinyin names from Chunghwa Post tables. Passport-specific and custom spellings are outside scope.

faq.question: Why can text downloads appear unreadable?
faq.answer: The text tables use Big5 encoding and need UTF-8 conversion. The XML tables already use UTF-8 and should not receive that conversion.

faq.question: What happens when a name matches multiple places?
faq.answer: The skill flags ambiguity and requests city or district context. Road and village tables do not include full administrative prefixes.

faq.question: What happens if a download link fails?
faq.answer: Check the official download index for a changed filename. Use official query pages when the required name or current boundary cannot be verified.
